scripts.start: concurrently -k -n BE,FE "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BE,FE "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
